{{Top|leg}}
The '''Universal Socket Interface''' (USI) was a non-proprietary standard for [[Droid/Legends|droid]] appendages, used since [[322 BBY/Legends|322 BBY]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] for the first time broke off with this standard by creating the [[Advanced Appendage Bus/Legends|Advanced Appendage Bus]] for its droids, which, according to the company's [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Illia Setag]], "more than triples the data-flow which will allow advancements in sensory input, perhaps allowing advanced tactile functionality for droids and [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetics]] in the near future".
